set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import commaParam from modules::SalesBatchKeys --- commaParam(vars.salesBatchSummary.uniqueCurrencies default [], ["EUR"])]
set-variable.doc:name: Frankfurter quotes param

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import upper from dw::core::Strings --- (payload default []) reduce ((item, acc = {}) -> acc ++ { (upper(item.quote default "")): item.rate })]
set-variable.doc:name: Quote to rate map

logger.doc:name: Frankfurter failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- '[correlationId=' ++ (vars.correlationId default 'n/a') ++ '] Frankfurter request failed; fx_rate / amount_eur will be null for non-EUR rows | ' ++ (error.description default '') ++ ' | type=' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '')]

logger.doc:name: Frankfurter skipped
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- "[correlationId=" ++ (vars.correlationId default "n/a") ++ "] Frankfurter skipped (only EUR or no currencies in batch)"]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import upper from dw::core::Strings var rows = vars.salesRows default [] var rates = vars.fxRateByQuote default {} --- rows map ((row) -> row ++ (do { var curr = upper(row.currency as String default "") var amt = row.amount_local as Number default null --- if ((row.currency default "") as String == "") { fx_rate: null, amount_eur: null } else if (curr == "EUR") { fx_rate: 1, amount_eur: amt } else (do { var r = rates[curr] --- if (r == null) { fx_rate: null, amount_eur: null } else { fx_rate: r, amount_eur: amt / r } }) }))]
set-variable.doc:name: Attach amount_eur fx_rate
